versions.changelog: The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

product-launch-opening-film 0.1.1

- Initial release.
- Generates three visual-tone stills and one stage-screen opening film clip for named product or brand launches.
- Accepts product/event name, launch message, and visual direction as required inputs.
- Delivers a labeled three-frame visual-tone board before any paid image.
- Confirms credits, counts, and client request IDs for all generate calls.
- All remote operations are executed via the bundled command-line client.
